title: A Walk through Leicester being a Guide to Strangers
author: Susannah Watts

authorInfo.bio: Susanna Watts (1768–1842) was an English abolitionist, writer and translator. She co-founded The Humming Bird anti-slavery periodical, campaigned against the purchase of Caribbean sugar or other products produced by slave labour and collected local signatures for the London Female Anti-Slavery Society’s national petition. She also wrote the first guide book of Leicester and founded the philanthropical organisation, the Society of the Relief of Indigent Old Age.

description: "A Walk through Leicester" by Susannah Watts is a historical guidebook composed in the early 19th century. The text serves as a detailed exploration of Leicester, providing insights into the town's history, architecture, and notable antiquities, catering to both travelers and local residents.
